title: SIGTERM drain keeps /readyz failing while in-flight work finishes
operatorStep: On the staging host, run `sudo systemctl kill --kill-who=main --signal=SIGTERM ultrathink-web.service` once, to signal the main process of the ultrathink-web unit. Do not run `systemctl stop` or `systemctl restart` on that unit during the run.
notes: Precondition: on the staging host, set ULTRATHINK_DRAIN_MS to at least 30000 in /etc/ultrathink/ultrathink.env and restart ultrathink-web.service so it reads the value. config.ts accepts 0 to 60000 and defaults to 5000, which is too short to observe. The drain begins on SIGTERM (services/ultrathink/lifecycle.ts beginDrain) and /readyz answers 503 while it lasts (obs/runtime.ts). Restart=always in deploy/ultrathink-web.service starts the unit again after the drain ends; that restart is expected and falls outside the observation window.

hypotheses.name: /readyz returns 503 while the SIGTERM drain is running
